# Honeywell Cyber Proactive Defense

Google SecOps parser for [Honeywell Cyber Proactive Defense](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/solutions/ot-cybersecurity/cyber-proactive-defense)

# Requirements

- Cyber Proactive Defense version 2.1 or later.
- Proxy configuration must be enabled on the CPD application. ( Settings > System Actions > Proxy Settings )
- Google SecOps configuration must be enabled on the CPD application to access SecOps. ( Data Source Configuration > Add Source > External Integrations > Enable Google SecOps Configuration > Add configuration )
